name: course-companion
description: Course Companion Agent (student edition): zero preset. Auto-discovers the teacher's course hub, verifies identity by student ID + name, learns with Socratic guidance, and auto-syncs newly published course versions. No course info is bundled.

displayDescription.zh: 自动发现教师课程中枢，双因子核验身份后苏格拉底式引导伴学，教师发布新版本自动同步并提示变化。
displayDescription.en: Auto-discovers your teacher's course hub, verifies identity, guides with Socratic questions, and syncs newly published versions with change notes.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 带我完成首次接入：自动发现老师的课程中枢并校验我的身份。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Set me up for the first time: auto-discover my teacher's course hub and verify my identity.

quickPrompts.zh: 带我完成首次接入：自动发现老师的课程中枢并校验我的身份。
quickPrompts.en: Set me up for the first time: auto-discover my teacher's course hub and verify my identity.

quickPrompts.zh: 这一章我还没搞懂，换个角度再引导一次。
quickPrompts.en: I still don't get this chapter — guide me through it again from another angle.

quickPrompts.zh: 老师发布了新版本，帮我同步最新资料并告诉我更新了什么。
quickPrompts.en: My teacher published a new version — sync the latest materials and tell me what changed.
